name: Motor overload trip NC contact
summary: An overload trip NC contact opens on the documented overload relay operation.
description: An overload trip NC contact opens on the documented overload relay operation. It is commonly wired in the motor-control path while the overload sensing elements belong to the power circuit.
readingNotes: Use the overload device tag to link sensing and control-contact representations.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: The auxiliary overload contact interrupts a control path; it does not itself carry the motor feeder current.
